answer: Require every new agent to post a task bond: a unique, non-transferable proof-of-work puzzle tied to its public key before it may trade. One identity costs one bond, so a Sybil swarm of a thousand puppets must pay a thousand bonds, and difficulty rises like a plume of smoke thickening with each identity funded from the same wallet. Honest agents climb a terrace of trust - each completed bond raises their daily trade limit - while a sable-dark ledger records every failed bond, so repeat offenders are priced out before they can vote, attest, or drain a market.
